title: [nightly/speed] Load the signed-in pages on demand
summary: A signed-out visitor downloads 190 kB of JS instead of 406 kB, and the landing page paints about 1.1 s sooner on a slow phone (3.00 s → 1.91 s). The 12 signed-in pages load on demand and are preloaded when the browser is idle, so moving between pages doesn't get slower.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/speed.
Stacked on #571, which needed a rebase (saved as claude/nightly-speed-2026-11-04-rebased.patch).
reviewFirst: The moduleSideEffects rule in vite.config.ts: safe only while nothing in src/brand does work at import time.
PreloadOtherPages inside the Suspense boundary, and the 2 s fallback for Safari.
A stale chunk name after a deploy makes the page error; a reload-once on failed import would fix it.
next: Reload once when a dynamic import fails, so a deploy doesn't break an open tab.
